title: Britain’s Starmer vows to prove ‘doubters’ wrong as he fights ouster calls
summary: Embattled British Prime Minister Keir Starmer on Monday vowed to prove his "doubters" wrong in a major speech aimed at quelling a mounting rebellion within his party after Labour suffered the worst local election results for a governing party in more than three decades last week.
